newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil to announce stock rules on CPMF tax soon.
newsitem.headline: Brazil to announce stock rules on CPMF tax soon.

text.p: The Finance Ministry is working on the final details of proposals to possibly exempt stocks from a new financial transaction tax and an announcement was expected either later Thursday or on Friday, an official said.
"It (a decree) is almost ready," said the official, who asked not to be named. He gave no further details.
Shares have been volatile amid speculation the government will find a way to exempt stock market transactions from the 0.2 percent CPMF tax, popularly known as the "check tax".
The levy comes into force on January 25 and, as it stands, will be charged on all financial transactions.
The Central Bank in particular has expressed concern that the tax could lead to capital flight by driving down returns for foreign investors in the stock markets.
The tax is designed to raise some 400 million reais a month to fund the health services.
